title: Existing logistics warehouse, building expansion with loading docks — Cataño, FEMA AE
description: Our logistics company already operates a warehouse in Cataño. We plan an expansion of the warehouse: a 10,000 square foot addition and new loading docks.

mustInclude.rationale: An expansion (ampliacion) of a building needs a construction permit under Ley 161-2009 / RC-2023; no KB rule keys on project_type=expansion (RULE_0643/0644 cover new_construction/renovation only).
RULE_0706: construction/expansion at a pin in the FEMA SFHA (location.flood_zone.sfha) -> Planning Regulation 13 flood review. (KB: RULE_0706, RULE_0707)

mustNotInclude.rationale: Existing business: normalizeEntityFormationRequirements never adds formation steps for existing_business / project_only, and entityNotFormed is false.
Pin outside the official coastal zone (NOAA CZMA answered 'outside'): RULE_0708 needs location.czm. A coastal-flagged municipio alone must not trigger it.
No SREP land and no change of use in a residential/conservation/agricultural district: RULE_0709-0712 cannot fire.
No renewable installation: RULE_0610 needs Q_RENEWABLE_INSTALL=true.
No renewable installation: RULE_0611 needs Q_RENEWABLE_INSTALL=true.
No microgrid stated: PT_MICROGRID needs microgrid_configuration=true; energy.test.ts: 'a rooftop system is not assumed to be a microgrid'.
No alcohol: RULE_0013/0014 need Q_ALCOHOL_SOLD / Q_ALCOHOL_SERVED; the business-type alcohol rules exist only for Bar / Juice Bar.

ordering.rationale: Reg. 13 compliance is part of the construction permit, which precedes the use permit.
